# Barbara Shaw

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Aunt Mary](../character/aunt-mary.md) (relative), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Barbara Shaw is a tall and awkward girl. She often gives the impression of having too many hands and feet.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## Personality

Barbara Shaw is known among the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) scholars for her remarkable clumsiness. Her frequent trips and stumbles, whether over her own feet or those of others, are so habitual that any instance of her walking down the aisle without falling is considered a noteworthy event.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## Traits

- clumsy  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)</sub>

## Abilities

_Not yet known._

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

Barbara Shaw moved to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to live with her aunt after having previously visited her [Aunt Mary](../character/aunt-mary.md) the prior winter. She became one of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's students at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P22](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0022), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P23](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0023), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), +112 more_

## Relationships

### [Aunt Mary](../character/aunt-mary.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-mary--barbara-shaw.md)

[Aunt Mary](../character/aunt-mary.md) is Barbara Shaw's aunt. She is mentioned as a family member in the letters and compositions transcribed by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her time teaching in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033)</sub>

### [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barbara-shaw--joseph.md)

[Joseph](../character/joseph.md) is Barbara Shaw's uncle. He is referenced as part of Barbara's extended family within the pupil compositions collected by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).
